review.scope: Injection-moulded nonpowered mechanical construction toy sets, including real element-specific material/grade, moulding, actual decoration and subassemblies, complete piece/instruction configuration and first whole-set release.
review.source_and_method: Root read both actual complete substantive LEGO web-tool text captures, with their historical403/missing publisher-original limits, and independently extracted actual retained Company Profile PDF10–11/printed16–18 including whole product testing and factory moulding/processing/packing. Two tool captures are not publisher HTML/PDF or independent factories; the complete PDF independently supports manufacturing/test context. Actual material page assigns different polymers by function; no all-ABS assumption, 230C/10s/pressure, safety test limits, capacity/recall/default quality claim transferred. Full IFC nonreactive plastics screening and ILCD conditional attributional context remain bounded. Real tooling, element production, actual whole formulation and extra on-site operations retain complete upstream/foreground ownership; missing ordinary quantities/provider identities and study QA are explicit, not zero.
review.native_and_classification: Full state100 finished constructional-toy family explicitly includes construction sets/building blocks alongside scale models and vehicles; genuine complete configured set fits Product Mass/kg. This narrower route does not borrow electric-train identity to hide powered electronics. Exact actual full native ABS/PP/HIPS/PC/hydraulic-fluid and utility property/route restrictions remain conditional per actual grade and supply; polymer labels do not establish all additives or supplier completeness. Old retired leaf/alias remains untouched; no one-PCR reuse or core component proxy.
review.event_stock_accounting: Complete original acceptance event/cohort fates, independent full wet stocks and gross legs versus attributable exchange/service vectors, own inherited history once, whole actual Qt and compatible nonoverlapping A/Q0 reviewed. No allocated physical receiver mass, extra component exports or duplicate providers.
review.bilingual: Scoped complete EN/ZH critical conditions and actual typed/literal/context/source/protocol/measurement/calculation/quality/inventory consistency reviewed; no scientific or empirical factory qualification.
review.remaining_limits: Actual measured configured quantities, real complete matched providers and source/matrix/dependency/site QA remain study obligations. Unestablished essential actual procedures stay holds; ordinary unresolved identities never become zeros/proxies.

pr34_repair.scope: Frontmatter/current review-state alignment verified against the retained independent review; unchanged methodology bodies and UUIDs.
